title: ICAI Announces One-Time Opportunity for CA Final Pass Candidates to Complete Remaining Training
content:
# ICAI Announces One-Time Opportunity for CA Final Pass Candidates to Complete Remaining Training

Ek important update hai! ICAI ne CA Final pass candidates ke liye ek one-time opportunity announce ki hai, jisse woh apni pending training requirements complete karke membership ke liye apply kar saken.

Yeh initiative un candidates ke liye hai jinhone CA Final exam pass kar liya hai but abhi tak Virtual Advanced Information Technology Training (Adv. ITT) aur Management & Communication Skills (MCS) Course complete nahi kiya hai, jo membership ke liye mandatory hai.

*   **What it is:** A special one-time window to complete the pending Virtual Advanced Information Technology Training (Adv. ITT) and Management & Communication Skills (MCS) Course.
*   **Who benefits:** Eligible CA Final pass candidates who need to fulfill these training requirements for ICAI membership.
*   **Why now:** To facilitate such candidates in obtaining their ICAI membership without further delay.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/category/important-announcements)

*Published on: 2 August 2026*
